title: Problems at home and work
descriptionFa: چیزهایی که خراب می‌شن، مشکلات روزمره‌ی خونه، و یه روز بد سر کار.

words.tipFa: گذشته‌ش: The coffee machine wasn't working.

words.example: The window is broken. Someone threw a ball through it.
Can you repair my phone screen?
words.tipFa: mend و fix هم همین معنی رو دارن. mend بیشتر برای چیزهای ساده: mend a shirt.

words.example: Save your work often in case the computer starts to crash.
The photocopier on the second floor is out of order.
I water the flowers every evening in summer.
My son's room is always untidy.
Please tidy your desk before you go home.
words.tipFa: صفت هم هست یعنی «مرتب»: a tidy room.
گذشته: lost. با loose (گشاد) قاطی نشه.

words.example: Be careful not to cut your finger on that knife.
Put a plaster on that cut.
Did you have a row with your brother again?
words.tipFa: row اینجا «راو» تلفظ می‌شه. have a row with someone.

words.example: You should apologise to your mum.
words.tipFa: apologise to someone for something. آمریکایی: apologize.

words.example: Did you have a bad day? You look tired.
Hurry up or we'll be late for school.
I can't come tonight. I have too much work.
words.tipFa: work غیرقابل‌شمارشه، پس much، نه many.

words.example: My colleague helped me with the report.
Don't talk to the boss now. He's in a bad mood.
